Definition: from G2596 and the base of G1476; to sit down:--sit.
BiblicalUsage: To sit down is what Jesus did at the well, wearied with His journey, and what the boy Jesus did in the temple among the doctors, and what He did daily in the temple teaching, and what the two angels did in the sepulchre, one at the head and one at the feet where the body had lain. The word holds the well, the temple, and the tomb together, and the same Lord sat in all three places.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the seated Jesus is the weary Jesus, the teaching Jesus, and the risen Jesus, and He is the same in all three. I hold that the angels sitting in the tomb are the proof that the sitting is finished, because the body is gone and the grave is empty.
